sloka: सुखप्रसुप्तं कालाग्निं निबोधयितुमिच्छसि।न्यस्यचापं निवर्तस्व मा प्राणान् जहि मद्गतः ।। ६.७१.५३ ।।
transliteration: sukhaprasuptaṁ kālāgniṁ nibodhayitumicchasi।nyasyacāpaṁ nivartasva mā prāṇān jahi madgataḥ ।। 6.71.53 ।।

translations.english: "Why do you want to arouse the fire of dissolution sleeping comfortably? Return, casting away your bow, without confronting. Go away."
